oh-every-morning-mercies-new-kelso.title: Every Morning Mercies New
oh-every-morning-mercies-new-kelso.body:
Verse 1:
[Bb]Ev'ry morn[Eb]ing [Bb]mercies new
Fall as fresh as [C7]morning [F]dew;
[Bb]Ev'ry [Eb]morning [D]let us [Gm]pay
[C7]Tribute [Dm]with the [C7]early [F]day:
[F7]For Thy [Gm]mercies, [D]Lord, are [Gm]sure;
[C7]Thy com[Bb]passion [F7]doth en[Bb]dure.

Verse 2:
[Bb]Still the great[Eb]ness [Bb]of Thy love
Daily doth our [C7]sins re[F]move;
[Bb]Daily, [Eb]far as [D]east from [Gm]west,
[C7]Lifts the [Dm]burden [C7]from the [F]breast;
[F7]Gives un[Gm]bought to [D]those who [Gm]pray
[C7]Strength to [Bb]stand in [F7]evil [Bb]day.

Verse 3:
[Bb]Let our prayers [Eb]each [Bb]morn prevail,
That these gifts may [C7]never [F]fail;
[Bb]And, as [Eb]we con[D]fess the [Gm]sin
[C7]And the [Dm]tempter's [C7]pow'r with[F]in,
[F7]Feed us [Gm]with the [D]Bread of [Gm]Life,
[C7]Fit us [Bb]for our [F7]daily [Bb]strife.

Verse 4:
[Bb]As the morn[Eb]ing [Bb]light returns,
As the sun with [C7]splendor [F]burns,
[Bb]Teach us [Eb]still to [D]turn to [Gm]Thee,
[C7]Ever [Dm]blessed [C7]Trini[F]ty,
[F7]With our [Gm]hands our [D]hearts to [Gm]raise,
[C7]In un[Bb]failing [F7]prayer and [Bb]praise.
